result:
Done. Two files delivered:

**`file-watcher.js`** (169 lines) — CLI entry point with three modes:
- `--watch`: long-lived process using `fs.watch(recursive)` on `library/` and `operations/command/records/`, 2-second debounce per file, batched flush
- `--once`: full scan comparing file mtimes against graph mtime, applies patches
- `--dry-run`: reports changes without writing (combinable with `--watch`)

**`graph-patcher.js`** (160 lines) — Incremental EAVT patch logic:
- Loads graph, indexes entities by `file-path`
- Updates: removes old triples for entity, inserts new ones at same eid
- Adds: assigns next available eid
- Removes: filters out all triples for deleted entity
- Falls back to full `generateGraph()` when a changed file introduces attributes not in the current attribute map
